component.description: Reference System Controller Firmware for SolidSense AIoT Board

components.name: embedded-resources-circular-buffer
components.description: Circular buffer from Embedded Artistry's embedded-resources

components.name: libgcc
components.description: GCC low-level runtime support library linked into the firmware, providing the integer division and switch-table helpers the compiler emits calls to. Distributed in GNU Tools for STM32 13.3.rel1.20240926-1715

pedigree.notes: Patched and built by STMicroelectronics for GNU Tools for STM32, so this is not the stock upstream release. The patch set and the sources it was built from are published in this component's source-distribution external reference.

components.name: newlib
components.description: C runtime library linked into the firmware, distributed in GNU Tools for STM32 13.3.rel1.20240926-1715

pedigree.notes: Patched and built by STMicroelectronics for GNU Tools for STM32, so this is not the stock upstream release. The patch set and the sources it was built from are published in this component's source-distribution external reference.

components.name: sths34pf80-pid
components.description: STHS34PF80 platform-independent register driver, the standard C driver for the infrared presence and motion sensor

components.name: stm32-ism330dhcx
components.description: ISM330DHCX BSP MEMS component driver for STM32Cube, with the platform-independent register driver it builds on

components.name: STM32CubeU0
components.description: STM32Cube MCU Full Package for the STM32U0 series - the HAL and LL drivers, the CMSIS device files for STM32U0, and Arm's CMSIS Core. Its constituent components are enumerated in the package's own SBoM, linked from this component's bom external reference

components.name: STM32CubeIDE
components.description: Bundles the STM32CubeMX code generator, and the GNU Tools for STM32 13.3.rel1.20240926-1715 toolchain whose runtime libraries are listed as components

workflows.name: Firmware build
workflows.description: STM32CubeIDE generates the HAL initialisation code from AIOT.ioc with its bundled STM32CubeMX, then compiles and links the result. The definition this describes is .github/workflows/build.yml, which also requires the generated code to match what is committed before it builds.
